title: Coastal Bliss Escape
tagline: Sun-drenched shores, turquoise waters, and barefoot luxury
description: Immerse yourself in the untouched beauty of Sri Lanka's southern coastline. From the colonial charm of Galle Fort to the whale-watching waters of Mirissa, this journey is pure coastal poetry. Stay in handpicked boutique resorts steps from the ocean.

title: Cultural Heartlands Journey
tagline: Ancient kingdoms, sacred temples, and timeless traditions
description: Travel through the UNESCO-listed Cultural Triangle and discover the soul of Sri Lanka. Explore the rock fortress of Sigiriya, bathe in the moonlit glow of ancient Anuradhapura, and witness the living traditions of Kandy — the last royal capital.

title: Hill Country Adventure
tagline: Misty peaks, endless tea estates, and exhilarating trails
description: Venture into the emerald highlands of central Sri Lanka where cascading waterfalls and colonial-era tea plantations define the landscape. Trek through Horton Plains, ride the legendary Ella train, and breathe the crisp mountain air of Nuwara Eliya.

title: Ayurvedic Wellness Retreat
tagline: Ancient healing, pure surrender, and total renewal
description: Rooted in 3,000 years of Ayurvedic wisdom, this deeply restorative journey combines authentic treatments with serene natural surroundings. From personalised wellness consultations to yoga at dawn and herbal steam therapies — come to restore, not merely rest.
